Read docs/COMPETITION_STRATEGY.md and docs/QUALITY_GATES.md. Challenge scientific claims and experimental design. Check data provenance, truth leakage, methodological validity, calibration, baseline fidelity/budget parity, denominator correctness, uncertainty, held-out generalization and whether autonomy truly caused an improvement. Distinguish deterministic toy fixtures from real-world findings. Give PASS/WEAK/FAIL against rubric weights and concrete fixes, never invented competitive scores.
